text_block_list.text: After going out with Vodka—

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Hey, you're heading home already? Isn't it 
still pretty early?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
This is totally kiddie bedtime. Let's take 
the scenic route, yeah?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Hey, I know just the place. I'll take ya 
there on a drive!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"Who cares about that! Just shut up and 
come with me!"

And so, without asking where we were 
going, I followed Vodka, and...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Um, I think if I keep going straight... it 
was a right turn, maybe?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"......Ah, the breeze really does feel so 
nice! Being out in nature is the absolute 
best~."

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! Guess the wind here really hits 
different from the city, huh? I don't hate 
it!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
So, which way was it again...? Wait, was 
there always this much nature out here?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Huh!? Of course I'm fine!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
W-Well, just leave Trainer to me and go 
relax while watching the sky or something.

Despite my anxiety, I continued following 
Vodka, and then...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: ...Where am I?!
I ended up getting lost after all...
choice_data_list: Where were you planning on going?
Where were you trying to go?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"...I was taking a random stroll a while 
ago, and I found a really nice-feeling 
rocky spot."

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"So, if I follow the route from back then, 
I should arrive... or so I thought."
choice_data_list: Wanna try searching on your phone?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
No way, I hate that! It kinda feels like 
admitting defeat...!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Daaagh, why aren't we there yet?! Is my 
memory playing tricks on me?!
choice_data_list: Let's just give up gracefully today!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, quick call... But you're right, no 
guarantee we'd make it if we kept going 
further anyway.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Dammit, guess I gotta start over.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I'm real sorry, Trainer! I ended up 
wasting your time.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Huh?

We walked around and talked about all 
sorts of things, and I told them that just 
doing that was fun enough.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: ...Well, even I...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
But still! I was planning on showing you 
around in a way cooler way!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
It was seriously such a nice rocky spot, 
and I really wanted to talk with you 
there...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Ahhh, that is seriously so frustrating! 
You've gotta let me have a rematch 
sometime!!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
It's a promise! That's a promise, 
alright?!

Working together to retrace our steps, we 
chatted the whole way back home.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Sixth... sense...?!?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: ...Whoaaa! What is that, that's so cool!!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Got it, leave it to me! Awaken, my sixth 
sense...!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Mmmmmmmmmm............!!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Gasp...!? Did I just... see some massive 
ruins nearby!?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Got it!

While Vodka was focused, I searched for 
nearby ruins on a map app and found a 
promising rocky area. Now, all that's left 
is—
choice_data_list: Thou shalt turn right in 200 meters……

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
......!?!? Did that voice just go... 
directly into my head!?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
No turning back now, all we can do is push 
forward...! Trainer, stay right on my 
tail!!

Even after that, I kept moving forward 
while guiding the enthusiastic Vodka, and 
then—

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: —Woooooooah!! We actually made itttttt~~!!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Holy crap, Trainer... I think I might've 
actually awakened to something crazy...!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha... Wahaha~~!! It is I, the awakened 
Umamusume, the great Vodka~~!!

Afterward, I kept an energized Vodka 
company, and we spent some time playing 
around the rocky shore.
